user: How will I receive updates about a dispute?
answer:
Every change in a dispute's status generates a notification. The notification states the new status but does not explain the internal reason for any decision.

The case moves through these states: open, under_review, provisional_credit, resolved_upheld, or resolved_declined. You can withdraw a dispute only while it is open or under_review. Withdrawal is final, and you cannot dispute the same transaction again under the same reason code.

I did not find the channel the notifications use (app, email, or SMS), so I can't confirm how they will reach you. Tell me which reason applies to TX-0401 and I'll run the eligibility check.

fragments.text:
Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Payment dispute rules
## Escalation on blocked disputes
When a dispute is blocked by a customer-level restriction, the case must be
escalated to a human agent.
